QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: authMethod
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Authentication method used by the MAVLink Console AI assistant.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: endpointUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint used by the MAVLink Console AI assistant.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: modelName
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Model name sent to the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: chatGptModelName
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Model identifier selected from the models provided by Codex App Server.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: apiKey
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Personal bearer token sent to the configured endpoint. Leave empty for local endpoints that do not require authentication.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthDeviceAuthorizationUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Deprecated OAuth 2.0 device authorization endpoint. This field is retained for settings compatibility and is not used by ChatGPT sign-in.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthTokenUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Deprecated OAuth 2.0 token endpoint. This field is retained for settings compatibility and is not used by ChatGPT sign-in.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthClientId
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Deprecated OAuth client ID. This field is retained for settings compatibility and is not used by ChatGPT sign-in.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: oauthScope
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Deprecated OAuth scope. This field is retained for settings compatibility and is not used by ChatGPT sign-in.
